description_en: Retrieves the billing module information of Web Application Firewall (WAF)
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-charge-module --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --pay-type POSTPAY --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeChargeModule

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

POSTPAY: a pay-as-you-go WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费类型。取值：
POSTPAY：表示按量付费 WAF 实例
parameters.name: pay_type
